answer: An auditor observes that every payout request must present a sable receipt whose nonce came from a registrar sequence, each position owned by one credential lineage. If two requests claim the same position, the later is void and both lineages are flagged. Violations are logged as a ripple entry mapping the disputed nonce to the credential that first consumed it, so replicas burn distinct slots instead of amortizing one. A violet markup escalates repeat offenders. Sequence arithmetic alone proves whether one or many credentials produced the work.
